entries.title: Psalms 87:1
segments: ¶<Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm. A Song.> This house is resting on the holy mountain.

entries.title: Psalms 87:2
segments: The Lord has more love for the doors of Zion than for all the tents of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 87:3
segments: Noble things are said of you, O town of God. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 87:4
segments: ¶Rahab and Babylon will be named among those who have knowledge of me; see, Philistia and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man had his birth there.

entries.title: Psalms 87:5
segments: And of Zion it will be said, This or that man had his birth there; and the Most High will make her strong.

entries.title: Psalms 87:6
segments: The Lord will keep in mind, when he is writing the records of the people, that this man had his birth there. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 87:7
segments: The players on instruments will be there, and the dancers will say, All my springs are in you.
